description: Use this when the person tells you a set they did. Give the session and slot from get_today or get_session, and the load and reps they said. Never invent a number. loadUnit kg or lb as they said it (label for a machine's own numbers); rir only if they say it. setNumber null logs the next set. Comes back with an Undo. Do not use to correct a set already logged; use edit_set.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

load.description: The weight they lifted, in loadUnit.

loadUnit.description: kg or lb as they said it, or label for a machine's own numbers. Null is kg, or the machine's numbers on a labelled machine.

rir.description: Reps in reserve, only when they say it; null otherwise.

sessionId.description: The session's id, from get_today or get_schedule.

setNumber.description: Which set, from 1. Null logs the next set not yet logged.

slot.description: The exercise's slot in that session, from get_today or get_session.

name: log_set
title: Log a set
